title: MemoryOS Architecture Overview
content: MemoryOS is a tiered memory engine with TLB Hot Cache (volatile fast access), Temporal Graph (relationships), and NVMe Checkpoints (persistent storage). No cloud dependency - fully local-first.

title: Heat Stream Engine Purpose
content: The Heat Stream monitors TLB Hot Cache for memory blocks with high access frequency and auto-formats them into Markdown snippets ready for LLM injection into system prompts.

title: Browser App Context Sync
content: ContextSyncBridge provides one-click sync from CLI heat cache to browser context window. Supports auto-injection into LLM prompts via {HOT_CONTEXT} placeholder.

title: User Preferences
content: User prefers alpine-based Docker images, efficient resource usage, and local-first approaches. Works with NVIDIA RTX 4090 on Windows PowerShell environment.

title: Development Workflow - MemoryOS
content: Initialize with 'memoryos init', build index with 'memoryos index', scan hot cache with 'memoryos tlb scan', export to markdown, inject into browser app LLM context.
